program.name: Athletic Balance
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Balance for sport: hops and sticks, lateral bounds, and single-leg strength.
program.about: Balance for sport and quick feet: hops and sticks, lateral bounds and star reaches, all about landing still. Single-leg strength follows so the landings have something behind them, then abs. Two days alternate the jumps. Levels II and III add reps. Land softly, and stop the set when landings get sloppy.
